name: barbell standing military press
description: A strict standing overhead press with a barbell. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructions: Unrack the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.
